skill.name: agy-worker
skill.description: Use when Codex or Claude Code should delegate repository exploration or implementation to Google Antigravity CLI (agy), then review, verify, repair, and deliver the result.
skill.summary: Delegate approved repository work to Antigravity CLI, then review candidate changes and record driver-owned verification.
skill.author: cagdasyurekli

security_audit.summary: Most supplied matches are defensive validation, fixed local tooling, or documentation; confirmed risks involve provider dispatch and unsandboxed candidate verification. Native grants also expose broad Keychain operations and unrestricted nonlocal port 443 destinations; no evidence found of deliberate exfiltration or audit manipulation. The analyzer omitted 272 additional matches, which remain unadjudicated and require manual review before automatic publication. Static review was capped at 400/672 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 272 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Session launches retain host authority and may start ambient plugin MCP servers.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit acknowledgement of ambient plugin execution, or provide an isolated session profile excluding user plugins before live dispatch.

remediation.issue: Driver verifiers can execute untrusted candidate code with user authority.
remediation.suggestion: Offer enforced filesystem and network isolation for driver verifiers. Keep credentials absent and use read-only gate checks plus separate verification copies.

remediation.issue: Native Keychain helper permissions are not limited to provider credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated provider-only Keychain or broker with fixed operations and item selection. Retain explicit approval until narrower enforcement exists.

remediation.issue: Native network policy permits arbitrary nonlocal port 443 recipients and potentially wildcard listeners.
remediation.suggestion: Enforce approved provider destinations through an authenticated egress broker and constrain listener bindings. Keep the current limitations explicit until enforcement is demonstrated.

remediation.issue: The static review catalog excludes 272 additional matches.
remediation.suggestion: Complete manual adjudication of the omitted matches before automatic publication. Do not interpret this completed catalog as complete package clearance.

content.user_title: Delegate Repository Work with Antigravity CLI
content.value_statement: Delegated repository changes need clear approval and independent verification. This skill coordinates Antigravity CLI jobs, scoped content previews, bounded repairs, and driver-owned acceptance.
actual_capabilities: Preview provider-readable repository content and bind exact tasks, settings, and budgets to approval digests.
Run explore, task, and project workflows through the bundled Antigravity CLI controller.
Stage selected repository paths in a private Gitless directory and reconcile only authorized changes.
Track local job status, preserve candidates, and support approved same-conversation repairs within configured limits.
Create verification copies and bind driver checks and diff review to a specific candidate.
Use optional native macOS containment for scoped provider work and network-free advisory self-verification.
limitations: Live jobs require Bash, Python 3, Git, Antigravity CLI, provider access, and explicit content and execution approval.
Default session mode is not host isolation and can retain ambient provider configuration and plugin execution.
Native containment requires supported macOS conditions; its network and Keychain grants are not provider-item or recipient allowlists.
Driver verification still requires trusted command selection; finalized assurance does not prove correctness or commit, merge, or publish changes.

use_cases.title: Explore an unfamiliar repository
use_cases.description: Delegate bounded architecture investigation, then spot-check reported findings and disclose coverage gaps.
use_cases.target_user: Developers onboarding to an existing codebase

use_cases.title: Add focused regression tests
use_cases.description: Approve selected source reads and test writes, inspect the returned diff, and run independent checks in a verification copy.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a bounded project repair
use_cases.description: Run an approved project workflow, return sanitized failures to the same conversation, and preserve useful partial work when budgets expire.

prompt_templates.title: Check local readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agy-worker to check offline readiness for [repository]. Do not launch AGY or inspect account settings. Report missing prerequisites and readiness limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: confirm local prerequisites without provider dispatch.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a scoped investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an explore preview for [question] in [repository]. Read only [paths]. Show the exact task, model, isolation, budget, and approval digest. Wait for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review the transmission boundary before repository exploration.

prompt_templates.title: Delegate a focused change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agy-worker for [change]. Read [paths] and write only [paths]. Obtain approval for the exact preview. Review the diff and independently run [checks].
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: delegate a bounded implementation with driver-owned verification.

prompt_templates.title: Repair and finalize a bound candidate
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [job] and its bound candidate. Review the diff and verify in a separate copy. Return sanitized failures for approved same-conversation repair. Preserve scope, model, isolation, and budget. Finalize only with current candidate-bound evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: manage candidate evidence, scoped repair authority, and final disposition.

output_examples.input: Prepare a preview for parser error-path tests without contacting the provider.
output: Status: awaiting approval; no provider task launched.
Readable scope: the selected parser source and existing tests.
Review packet: exact task, selected settings, scope digest, and launch approval digest.

output_examples.input: Report a candidate with a passing focused test but unavailable full-suite verification.
output: Review: candidate diff inspected against the approved write scope.
Checks: the focused test passed in a separate verification copy.
Remaining gap: the full suite was not available.
Candidate preserved; no commit, merge, or publication performed.

output_examples.input: Explain a native-containment prerequisite failure before live execution.
output: The requested native containment could not start under the current host conditions.
Isolation selection remains unchanged; no automatic fallback or retry occurred.

best_practices: Approve the exact preview and smallest practical read/write scope; exclude secrets, private logs, and executable provider configuration.
Review candidate diffs independently and run project checks in a separate verification copy without ambient credentials.
Preserve model, isolation, and budgets across repairs; bind final assurance to current evidence and disclose incomplete checks.
anti_patterns: Treating installation, a content digest, or offline readiness as permission for provider execution or transmission.
Executing commands claimed by the worker or exposing credentials merely to reproduce an ambient test environment.
Treating scoped staging as a sandbox, silently changing isolation, or publishing work based only on a worker report.

faq.question: Which assistant hosts are supported?
faq.answer: The package supports Codex CLI and Claude Code as driver hosts. Live delegated work runs through Antigravity CLI.

faq.question: What does installation require?
faq.answer: Install the complete package and provide Bash, Python 3, Git, and Antigravity CLI. Live jobs also need provider access.

faq.question: Can I preview content without contacting the provider?
faq.answer: Yes. Transmission preview computes local scope and approval bindings without launching AGY. Offline readiness does not prove authentication.

faq.question: Does selected-content staging isolate my computer?
faq.answer: No. Session mode retains normal host authority. Optional native macOS containment narrows access but retains documented network and Keychain limitations.

faq.question: How are results accepted?
faq.answer: The driver reviews the candidate and binds independent checks to its digest. Worker reports and advisory self-verification do not establish acceptance.

faq.question: Will finalization commit or publish changes?
faq.answer: No. Finalization records driver assurance. Git actions and publication need separate authorization, and incomplete verification must remain explicit.
